items.title: The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady's Treasure
items.synopsis: The curtains rise on a new mystery surrounding a secret treasure hidden in a city on the water.

items.title: WONDERING MATE
items.synopsis:
Aco, a high school girl avatar who dreams of becoming human, and Bit, an avatar who wants nothing to do with becoming human.

A story of two avatars who may be changing, in a world that was never supposed to change.

items.title: Disney Twisted-Wonderland The Animation Season 2: Episode of Savanaclaw
items.synopsis: Anime adaptation of Disney's Japanese mobile game by Aniplex.

items.title: The Reincarnated Elf Left on a Journey to Master His Magic and With His Extra Lifespan Became a Living Legend
items.synopsis: Minoru Kido, a 30-year-old salaryman, is killed in a traffic accident. He is reincarnated into another world as an elf named Liese Klein. In this new world, elves have a lifespan of up to a thousand years. However, he becomes bored of staying at home, still retaining memories of the time before his death. Wanting to experience a fulfilling life, in contrast to his previous short life, he decides to leave home, much to his family's hesitation. However, after the local village chief appears, challenging him to reach his full magic potential within a hundred years, he sets off on his journey.

items.title: Wanpaku! Touken Ranbu
items.synopsis: عمل قصير مستوحى من عالم Touken Ranbu، يعيد تقديم شخصيات السيوف الشهيرة في هيئة لطيفة ومبسطة، ضمن مواقف يومية خفيفة ومغامرات تناسب الطابع المرح للعمل.

items.title: Multi-mind Mayhem
items.synopsis: Bard Cornelius may be the young heir to a noble family, but he is far from ordinary: three souls inhabit a single body. Alongside Bard's own consciousness reside Oka Sanai Sadatoshi, a Sengoku-era warrior, and Masaharu Oka, a modern-day high school otaku. Drawing on their combined knowledge and abilities, Bard becomes a formidable fighter, inventor and entrepreneur, setting him on a path that could shape the fate of an entire kingdom.

items.title: Spirit Circle
items.genre: Action، Adventure، Comedy، Drama، Romance، Reincarnation
items.synopsis: Fuuta Okeya can see ghosts. Besides that—and the bandage he always keeps on his cheek—he’s a perfectly normal 14-year old boy enamoured with the new transfer student. Unfortunately, Kouko Ishigami wants little to do with him. A strange ghost that follows her, however, seems to feel quite differently. But, when Kouko sees the strange birthmark hidden beneath the bandage on Fuuta’s cheek, she has a change of heart…for the worse. Not only does she denounce him as her enemy, but she claims that the birthmark is a curse she engraved upon his face during one of their many past lives. What happened between Kouko and Fuuta, and what is the connection to the strange, fantastical dreams that Fuuta begins to experience?

items.title: Haru to Gen ~70-sai, Hajimete no Kosodate~
items.synopsis: بعد وفاة ابنته التي انقطعت صلته بها لسنوات، يجد غين، الرجل السبعيني الذي اعتاد العيش وحيدًا، نفسه مسؤولًا عن حفيدته هارو ذات الأعوام الثلاثة. ومن خلال رعايته لها، يبدأ في اكتشاف معنى العائلة من جديد.

items.title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun: IruMafia Edition
items.synopsis: Iruma is a dirt-poor but unfailingly cheerful young boy who grows up in a ruthless city slum. One day, Iruma gives an injured old man his last loaf of bread and nurses the stranger back to health—only to find out that the elder gent is none other than Don Sullivan, head of the Babyl Mafia! Soon after, Don Sullivan comes back, whisks Iruma away, and begs the boy to become his grandson. And just like that, Iruma begins his new life as the next in line to lead a gigantic gang of—dare we say—demonic mafiosos!

items.title: Shin Oishinbo
items.synopsis: يعود الصحفي المتخصص في الطعام شيرو يامااوكا إلى مغامراته في عالم الطهي، حيث تتشابك المنافسة بين مشروعي «القائمة المثالية» و«القائمة الأسمى» مع العلاقات الشخصية، وعلى رأسها علاقته بزميلته يوكو كوريـتا.

items.title: Magical Buffs: The Support Caster is Stronger Than He Realized!
items.synopsis: Wim Strauss is a “granting caster”—a support mage who can increase the strength of his allies through the power of his spells. It’s a useful talent, but since it can’t be used directly in battle, it gets zero respect from the other members of his party. As far as they’re concerned, support magic is dead weight. It isn’t long before they toss him out on his ear, leaving Wim to wonder if his career as an adventurer is over.

items.title: Mera × Death: The Strange Love Between Me and the Reaper
items.synopsis: في مدينة شهدت انفجارًا هائلًا انتهى بمعجزة دون سقوط ضحايا، يعيش الفتى ميرا حياة رتيبة إلى أن يلتقي بالفتاة الغامضة ثيرتين في عيد ميلاده السادس عشر. يغيّر لقاؤهما حياته، بالتزامن مع بدء وقوع أحداث غير مألوفة في المدينة.

items.title: Gacha Girls Corps
items.synopsis: UR-GUARANTEED—TO HAVE THE ADVENTURE OF A LIFETIME!

items.title: CHARISMA
items.synopsis:
This is Charisma House.

Today, as always, these charismatic men are gazing deep into their own charisma.

And yet, it would be fair to say they have not yet reached the level of ‘true charisma.’

That is why they live together under one roof, nurturing their own charisma day by day, striving for even greater heights. —a temporary sanctuary, if you will.

There may be those out there who mock them.

But such things cause absolutely no damage to these charismatic men.

If anything, they take such adversity to generate even more charisma,

Building up a brilliant “Charisma Charge”.

What lies beyond this Charisma Charge……!?

It might be hard for ordinary people to understand,

But this is the story of the Charismas.

items.title: Otherworldly Munchkin: Let's Speedrun the Dungeon with Only 1 HP!
items.synopsis: 16-year-old Yukito Kirihara lives with his 14-year-old sister Sana, who he treasures more than anyone else. But when an ogre shows up outside of his window looking for Sana (a shocking event in its own right), Yukito leaps to save her—and is killed. He’s offered the promise of reincarnation by a mysterious woman, who gives him a character sheet in a mysterious book. But when Yukito sees Sana in there, too, he sets off to find her, and save them both—even if he only has 1 hp with which to do it!

items.title: I Lost My Adventurer's License, but It's Fine Because I Have an Adorable Daughter Now
items.synopsis: Douglas, once known as a legendary enhancement spellcaster, is now little more than your average, weak old man. On top of that, he was kicked out of the hero party, and eventually had his adventurer's license revoked... And that's how he ended up a vagabond, wandering aimlessly. After an encounter with Rabi, a cursed little girl, a new adventure begins...

items.title: Are You a Landmine, Chihara-san?
items.synopsis: It’s the start of a new semester, and high school junior Kuroki finds himself seated beside the girl everyone whispers about: Mai Chihara. With her gothic fashion, jet-black hair, and intense stare, Chihara is said to be a “landmine” girl or jirai-kei, the hyper-feminine, dark aesthetic often associated with yandere tendencies and unstable personalities. But when Kuroki accidentally draws Chihara’s attention, he discovers she isn’t nearly as unstable as people claim. Beneath the intimidating aura is a surprisingly sweet girl… if a little weird.

items.title: BanG Dream! MyGO!!!!! // Ave Mujica
items.synopsis: تتقاطع حكايات فرقتي MyGO!!!!! وAve Mujica في عالم الموسيقى، حيث تحاول الفتيات التعامل مع ماضيهن ومشاعرهن المتشابكة، بينما تصبح العلاقات والاختيارات الشخصية جزءًا أساسيًا من رحلتهن على المسرح وخارجه.

items.title: BLESS
items.synopsis: At a young age, Aia Utagawa was scouted as a model, but his real ambition is to become a makeup artist. But, even as the end of high school approaches, it’s a dream he hides inside, afraid of stepping outside his prescribed role as a pretty face. Then, one day, he meets Jun, a quiet classmate who hunches because she’s ashamed of her face, covered in freckles. He convinces her to enter a school runway fashion contest together—with him doing her makeup. They make an incredible team, with Jun discovering a confidence she never knew she could show and Aia finally learning that, while it may be tough to open yourself up to failing at the one thing you care about, the difficulties can be worth facing.

items.title: YAIBA: Samurai Legend Season 2
items.synopsis: يواصل ياِيبا مغامراته في آرك كاغويا، مع ظهور تهديد جديد يستهدف ساياكا. وبين قوى السيوف الأسطورية وصراعه المتجدد مع أونيمارو، يجد ياِيبا نفسه أمام مواجهة أكبر تكشف المزيد عن القوى الغامضة التي تحيط بهم.

items.title: The Eternal Fool's Words of Wisdom: A Pawsitively Fantastic Adventure
items.synopsis: A couple thousand years of solitude would wear down any young man—that is, anyone except Asley, an eternally youthful and eternally foolish sorcerer. After all, he has man’s best friend...er, familiar, to keep him company. When his Level 100 canine companion Pochi demands that he get some fresh air for the first time in two centuries, Asley sets out to reintegrate into society and test his magic mettle. His mission? Dropping several unglamorous titles from his repertoire and restoring his good (okay, decent) name. A brand-new world and fresh adventures await Asley after his many years of hermitage. Perhaps he’ll lend Pochi a hand to place first in the mysterious Familiar Feud. Or maybe he’ll lose all vestiges of dignity and turn tail. Whichever comes first! No matter what, Asley has great evil to fight, a big world to save, and even a little growing up to do...that is, if he can endure Pochi’s “friendly advice” along the way!

items.title: MASHLE: MAGIC AND MUSCLES The Tri-Magicathlon Divine Visionary Final Exam Arc
items.genre: Action، Comedy، Fantasy، Gag Humor، School، Parody
items.synopsis: في عالم تُحدد فيه قيمة الإنسان بقدرته على استخدام السحر، يواصل ماش بيرنيديد رحلته لإثبات نفسه رغم افتقاره إلى أي قدرة سحرية. وبعد اجتياز الاختبارات السابقة، يواجه هو وأصدقاؤه التحدي الأكبر في منافسات Tri-Magicathlon، سعيًا للوصول إلى لقب الرؤية الإلهية.

items.title: The Fable 2nd Season
items.synopsis: بعد أن أُجبر القاتل المحترف المعروف باسم فابل على الابتعاد عن عالم الاغتيالات والعيش بهدوء بهوية عادية، تبدأ مرحلة جديدة تهدد حياته الهادئة. يتناول الموسم الثاني آرك ياماoka، مع عودة المؤامرات والأخطار إلى محيطه.

items.title: Josemaru
items.synopsis: يتابع العمل الحياة اليومية لجرو صغير أبيض وفروي يُدعى جوزيمارو، يحاول إنجاز ما عليه من مهام، لكنه كثيرًا ما يتعثر ثم يستمتع بقيلولة أو قطعة دونات. حكايات بسيطة ودافئة عن جوزيمارو والكائنات الصغيرة من حوله.

items.title: Shangri-La Frontier Season 3
items.synopsis: يواصل راكورو هزوتومي، المعروف بشغفه بتحدي الألعاب السيئة، مغامرته داخل لعبة الواقع الافتراضي Shangri-La Frontier. ومع اتساع عالم اللعبة وتكوّن التحالفات، تقوده التحديات الجديدة إلى مواجهات وأسرار تتجاوز حدود اللعب المعتادة.

items.title: Love Live! Hasunosora Jogakuin School Idol Club
items.synopsis: تدور الأحداث حول طالبات مدرسة هاسونوسورا اللواتي يجتمعن في نادٍ للآيدول المدرسي، ويعملن على تطوير عروضهن الموسيقية وبناء روابط الصداقة والتعاون، بينما يواجهن تحديات الحياة المدرسية والسعي لتحقيق أحلامهن.

items.title: Peropero Sparkles
items.synopsis: اقتباس تلفزيوني لمشروع الشخصيات اللطيفة الذي ابتكرته الرسامة يوري سيكيا، ويقدم عالمًا مليئًا بشخصيات كرتونية ذات عيون لامعة وتصميمات مرحة. يأتي الأنمي ضمن مشروع أوسع لتوسيع العلامة عبر المحتوى والفعاليات والمنتجات.

items.title: Mercedes and the Waning Moon
items.synopsis: Reincarnated as a vampire to a noble father and his shunned concubine, Mercedes Grunewald has always known that one day, her father will choose an heir that isn’t her. But what will become of her family when that time comes? Her mother has no skills, their maid is old, and Mercedes is but a small child. How will they survive in the world on their own?

items.title: Tamala 2030: A Punk Cat in Dark
items.synopsis: Carefree, coquettish, and capricious, Tamala is the cutest girl-cat in dystopian Cat Tokyo, year 2030—or at any other point in the time/space continuum. She has randomly invited herself along on her detective friend Michelangelo’s missing-person investigation. It seems the case is one of seven sudden vanishings in an astronomical pattern across Cat Japan that occurred at the exact same moment one night. Their search leads ever deeper into a mystery with ancient, occult roots and apocalyptic implications—and threads leading to Tamala herself. Shadowed by a covert agent of the Catty & Co. consortium, she may in fact be the greatest enigma. Indolent ingénue? Megacorporate mascot? Mythic messiah, or manifestation of cosmic malevolence? Anyhow, wow—she sure is a great dancer!

items.title: One-Punch Man Season 3 Specials
items.genre: Action، Adult Cast، Comedy، Parody، Super Power
items.synopsis: حلقات خاصة مرافقة للموسم الثالث من One-Punch Man، تعود إلى عالم الأبطال الخارقين وتقدم مواقف جانبية وشخصيات من السلسلة. لم يُعلن عن تفاصيل قصص الحلقات كلٌّ على حدة.

items.title: Akane-banashi Season 2
items.synopsis: “What you’re about to experience is nothing less than the living history of Rakugo.”

items.title: ARCANADEA
items.synopsis: Anime based on Kotobukiya's plastic model kit series ARCANADEA.

items.title: Because I, the True Saint, was Banished, that Country is Done For!
items.synopsis: Saint Eliane’s engagement is called off out of the blue by her fiancée, the crown prince Claude, who then banishes her from the kingdom. Fed up with Claude’s incessant bullying and unfaithfulness, Eliane sets off to a neighboring kingdom in the hopes of starting a new life. It is then that she meets Nigel, a man of sincerity and an exact opposite of Claude…

items.title: Bride of the Barrier Master
items.synopsis: For thousands of years, Japan has been protected by five clans wielding barrier-weaving magic. Born to a branch family of one such clan, eighteen-year-old Hana has always been stuck in the shadow of her more capable, beautiful, and popular twin sister. When a strong power awakens within Hana, she chooses to hide it so she can continue living a quiet life out of the spotlight. But that ideal lifestyle begins to slip out of reach when Saku Ichinomiya takes over as the new head of the Ichinomiya clan and sets out to find a bride strong enough to stand by his side. Eager to keep her abilities secret, Hana steers clear of Saku... but will she be tempted to sign a marriage contract if it guarantees the peaceful, quiet future of her dreams?

items.title: Dengeki Daisy
items.synopsis: After orphan Teru Kurebayashi loses her beloved older brother, she finds solace in the messages she exchanges with DAISY, an enigmatic figure who can only be reached through the cell phone her brother left her. Meanwhile, mysterious Tasuku Kurosaki always seems to be around whenever Teru needs help… Could DAISY be a lot closer than Teru thinks?

items.title: Everyday HOST CLUB (Sequel)
items.genre: Adult Cast، Comedy، Gag Humor، Workplace
items.synopsis: تعود مجموعة العاملين في نادٍ للضيافة لتقديم مواقف كوميدية من حياتهم اليومية، بين محاولات إرضاء الزبائن والتعامل مع طباع بعضهم الغريبة والمواقف غير المتوقعة داخل النادي وخارجه. لم تُكشف بعد تفاصيل دقيقة عن نقطة بداية الجزء الجديد.

items.title: Getting Shots on a Frying Pan
items.genre: Adult Cast، Gourmet، Slice of Life
items.synopsis: لم يتوفر حتى الآن ملخص رسمي تفصيلي موثوق للعمل. أُدرجت هذه النبذة التعريفية مؤقتًا اعتمادًا على بيانات العمل المتاحة، وينبغي تحديثها عند نشر تقديم القصة من الجهة المنتجة.

items.title: Hirayasumi
items.synopsis: At 29 years old, carefree Hiroto Ikuta doesn’t have a girlfriend, a full-time job, or a plan for the future—and he couldn’t be happier. Hiroto’s breezy attitude isn’t easy for everyone to understand, though. In a world filled with anxiety, confusion, and grief, Hiroto and the people who surround him are all just doing their best to figure out this thing called life.

items.title: Historié
items.synopsis:
It is the fourth century, B.C. 

Eumenes is a young man with ample knowledge and education who encounters the great philosopher Aristotle and is headed together with him to the city-state of Cardia. 

That is Eumenes’s homeland, and the place where it all “began“—

items.title: I Got a Cheat Skill in Another World and Became Unrivaled in The Real World, Too Season 2
items.synopsis: يواصل يوجا تينجو حياته بين العالمين، بعدما اكتشف بوابة تقوده من غرفته إلى عالم آخر مليء بالوحوش والقدرات الخارقة. ومع ما اكتسبه من قوة غيرت حياته في العالمين، يواجه تحديات جديدة بينما يحاول التوفيق بين حياته اليومية ومغامراته.

items.title: Inherit the Winds
items.synopsis: During the Bakumatsu era in the city of Kyoto, a soldier, his memories lost, is aided by Soji Okita, assistant officer of the Mibu Roshigumi.

items.title: Isshiki-san Wants to Know About Love
items.synopsis: The straitlaced and serious police inspector Isshiki has earned the respect of everyone around her, but lately, she hasn’t quite been herself at work. Whenever her coworker Rokutanda is around, she gets flustered and slips up! Having no experience with such complicated feelings, Isshiki decides to enter a pseudo-relationship with Rokutanda and figure out what this love thing is all about!

items.title: Komadori Mofmof Parade
items.synopsis: عمل ذو طابع لطيف يتمحور حول شخصيات صغيرة مستوحاة من عالم الطيور والكائنات المحببة، ويقدم مواقف قصيرة ومرحة في أجواء احتفالية. لم يتوفر حتى الآن وصف رسمي مفصل للحبكة أو الشخصيات.

items.title: Living It Up in Another World Until I Get Bored
items.synopsis: As if the universe heard him, his journey begins sooner than expected. On his way home, he suddenly finds himself stranded in another world-a strange, game-like place governed by levels, magic, skills, and other fantastical rules. And before he knows it, he's acquired tremendous power without even having to work for it.

items.title: MARRIAGETOXIN Season 2
items.synopsis: يواصل هيكارو غيرو، الوريث القادم لعائلة متخصصة في السموم، مهمته غير المعتادة للعثور على شريكة والزواج، بمساعدة مصممة حفلات الزفاف ميي كينجو. وبينما يتنقلان بين مواقف اجتماعية معقدة، تستمر مهمتهما وسط عالم مليء بالأسرار والمواجهات.

items.title: Medaka Kuroiwa is Impervious to My Charms Season 2
items.synopsis: تحاول مونا كواي، الفتاة المعتادة على جذب إعجاب الجميع، لفت انتباه ميداكا كورويوا، الطالب الجديد الذي لا يتأثر بسحرها ولا يمنحها الاهتمام الذي اعتادته. ومع استمرار محاولاتها، تتحول المنافسة العاطفية بينهما إلى سلسلة من المواقف الكوميدية داخل المدرسة.

items.title: One-Punch Man Season 3 Part 2
items.genre: Action، Adult Cast، Comedy، Parody، Super Power
items.synopsis: يستكمل الجزء الثاني أحداث الموسم الثالث، مع استمرار المواجهة بين جمعية الأبطال وجمعية الوحوش. وبينما تتصاعد المعركة داخل مقر الأعداء، تتشابك مصائر الأبطال، في الوقت الذي يقترب فيه سايتاما من قلب الأحداث بطريقته المعتادة.

items.title: Ramen Akaneko Season 2
items.synopsis: في مطعم رامن تديره مجموعة من القطط، تحصل تاماكو على وظيفة بعد أن تعترف بأنها تفضل الكلاب على القطط. لكنها تكتشف أن مهمتها ليست تقديم الطعام، بل الاعتناء بالقطط والعاملين في المطعم، لتبدأ حكايات يومية دافئة تجمع بين الطعام والزبائن والروابط الإنسانية.

items.title: Red Riding Hood: A Detective Story
items.synopsis:
On the outskirts of town lived a girl called “Red Riding Hood.”

One day, she found herself forced to embark on a journey for a certain purpose.

Strangely enough, however, she kept getting swept up in incident after incident along the way.

Using her innate curiosity and clever mind, Red Riding Hood set about solving each mystery.

items.title: Reincarnation in the Game World Dankatsu: Game Addict Plays "Encouragement for Job Hunting in Dungeons" from a "New Game"
items.synopsis: A legendary god-tier game, "Dungeon Job Hunting Recommendation", aka "DanKatsu", features an unprecedented 1,021 playable job classes and over 400 different endings! The more you play, the stronger you become, unlocking new abilities and rare items.

items.title: Sekiro: No Defeat (TV)
items.synopsis: في حقبة الحروب باليابان، يحاول النينجا المعروف باسم الذئب حماية سيده الشاب كورُو، صاحب دم التنين الذي يمنح قوة الخلود. وبين مطامع القوى المحيطة بهما والآثار القاسية لهذه القدرة، ينطلق الذئب في رحلة شاقة بحثًا عن وسيلة لإنهاء دورة الخلود.

items.title: Spice and Wolf: MERCHANT MEETS THE WISE WOLF Season 2
items.genre: Adult Cast، Adventure، Drama، Fantasy، Romance
items.synopsis: يواصل التاجر المتجول كرافت لورانس والذئبة الحكيمة هولو رحلتهما شمالًا، ويصلان إلى مدينة ساحلية بحثًا عن فرص تجارية جديدة. وهناك يخوضان مفاوضات وصفقات معقدة، ويلتقيان بأشخاص جدد، فيما تتطور الثقة والرابطة بينهما خلال الرحلة.

items.title: SSS-Class Revival Hunter
items.synopsis: A mysterious tower crawling with monsters has suddenly appeared, drawing Hunters willing to risk their lives for glory and riches. Gongja Kim, a weak F-rank Hunter, spends his days envying the Flame Emperor who reigns as the top Hunter. But his chance at greatness finally arrives when he joins forces with the Sword Emperor and gains a rare S-rank skill, with one catch: he must die to activate it.

items.title: Tales of Matsurika: The Girl Who Never Forgets
items.synopsis:
Matsurika, a lady-in-waiting in the inner palace, has a special talent―an excellent memory.

She agrees to act as a practice matchmaking partner for the son of a prominent family, but the one who showed up was Emperor Hakuyou!

Impressed by Matsurika's talent, Hakuyou suddenly tells her to pass the imperial examinations.

This is a Chinese Cinderella story about a girl whose talent is noticed by the emperor.

items.title: The Diary of a Middle-Aged Sage's Carefree Life in Another World
items.genre: Action، Adventure، Fantasy، Isekai، Video Game، Reincarnation
items.synopsis: Forty-year-old Satoshi Osako is a farmer in the Japanese countryside—and a hardcore player of Swords & Sorceries, an online VRRPG. The day he finally manages to defeat the game's final boss, it curses him with its dying breath and kills him in real life! With a little help from a carefree goddess, Satoshi finds himself reincarnated into a mysterious new world as his in-game character, the incredibly powerful Great Sage known as Zelos Merlin. He accordingly decides to use his newfound powers to...continue living a quiet life on another farm! But first, he'll have to fight his way out of the vast, dangerous forest he woke up in—thanks a lot, goddess—and it won't be long before he's running into bandits, getting roped into teaching a young noble girl magic, and more. Will the almighty Great Sage be able to conquer the toughest quest of all: getting some peace and quiet?

items.title: The Final-Boss Prince is Somehow Obsessed with the Chubby Villainess: Reincarnated Me
items.synopsis: After dying of illness, she has been reincarnated as Celine, the selfish, fat, villainous duchess, sister of the heroine of a popular novel. If she stays this way, she will be killed by the hero prince and die a miserable death, just as in the novel. She vows to reform herself with all her might and begins to struggle, but she finds herself caught up in unexpected doting and obsession! Will Celine be able to find "peaceful happiness"?

items.title: The Fledgling Demon Lord's Starter Shop
items.synopsis: After the hero defeated the demon lord, the world is finally at peace... leaving the young Villager of Beginnerville in a bind! Without a demon lord to defeat, people have no need for potions and items...leaving Villager's item shop, The Nest, empty and lifeless. At this rate, Villager might have to close The Nest...! But then suddenly a mysterious girl appears and everything changes...

items.title: The Kept Man of the Princess Knight
items.synopsis: The Dungeon City is a wicked place filled with crime, debauchery, and death. Its one shining light is Arwin, the beautiful Crimson Princess Knight. She and her brave party of adventurers descend into the dungeon at the city's center, seeking a legendary treasure with the power to rebuild the princess's fallen kingdom. Many yearn to be by her side, but that spot is already taken by Matthew, a man despised by all in town as a cowardly weakling. Everyone thinks he is scum who just spends her hard-earned money on booze, women, and gambling. No one in the city—not even the princess knight— knows what Matthew is truly capable of.

items.title: The World's Finest Assassin Gets Reincarnated in Another World as an Aristocrat Season 2
items.genre: Action، Drama، Fantasy، Isekai، Mystery، Magic
items.synopsis: بعد أن أُعيد تجسيد أعظم قاتل في العالم داخل عالم خيالي بوصفه الابن الأكبر لعائلة أرستقراطية متخصصة في الاغتيال، يتلقى مهمة من إلهة للقضاء على البطل الذي يُتنبأ بأنه سيدمر العالم. ويستخدم خبرته السابقة ومعارفه الجديدة وقدرات عائلته لتنفيذ المهمة.

items.title: Though I Am an Inept Villainess Cour 2
items.synopsis:
Through the actions of Reirin and Keigetsu, the series of disturbances caused by a curse in the inner court have settled down.

Through their swap, Reirin and Keigetsu learned of each other’s character, and a friendship was budding between the two of them.

items.title: Tsugumi Project
items.synopsis: More than two centuries have passed since Japan was devastated by nuclear war. Cut off from the world, the island is now a place of terror and mysteries: wonders of science some believe best forgotten, monuments to a bygone era of human decadence, and irradiated monsters ready to tear apart any humans foolish enough to set foot there.

items.title: Mobile Suit Gundam SEED FREEDOM ZERO
items.synopsis: After the collapse of the Destiny Plan proposed by Dullindal, which would have decided people's fates based on genetics, Cagalli, the chief representative of the Orb United Emirates, has been working to bring about a peaceful new order by establishing a global peace monitoring agency called COMPS (Pronounced Compass).

items.title: SAKAMOTO DAYS Season 2
items.genre: Action، Adult Cast، Comedy، Organized Crime
items.synopsis: يعود تارو ساكاموتو، القاتل الأسطوري السابق الذي اختار حياة هادئة مع عائلته، إلى دوامة المخاطر عندما يتعاون مع شين للتسلل إلى مؤسسة JCC وجمع معلومات عن «إكس» المعروف باسم سلور. وفي الوقت نفسه، يواجه أعضاء منظمة ORDER مهمة خطيرة في كيوتو، فيما تبدأ أسرار الماضي في الظهور.

items.title: Aikatsu Stars! ~Hoshiboshi no Progress~
items.synopsis: عمل جديد من عالم Aikatsu Stars! الذي يتابع فتيات يسعين إلى تطوير مواهبهن في الغناء والرقص والأزياء، وخوض اختبارات وعروض تساعدهن على التقدم في طريقهن ليصبحن نجمات آيدول. لم يُنشر حتى الآن ملخص تفصيلي مستقل لهذا الإصدار.

items.title: Pole Princess!! -Croix du Nord-
items.synopsis: امتداد لعالم Pole Princess!! الذي يتابع مجموعة فتيات يكتشفن رياضة الرقص على العمود ويعملن على تطوير مهاراتهن وتقديم عروض تجمع بين الأداء الرياضي والتعبير الفني. يركز هذا الإصدار على مجموعة Croix du Nord.

items.title: THE ONE PIECE
items.genre: Action، Adventure، Comedy، Drama، Super Power، Fantasy
items.synopsis: Remake of One Piece.

items.title: Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club The Movie – Finale
items.genre: Idols (Female)، Music، School، Slice of Life
items.synopsis:
Chapter 1

After the return of foreign student Aira, the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club receives an invitation to the prestigious School Idol Grand Prix (GPX) – a solo competition where idols perform on a streaming app to determine the most popular school idol.

items.title: ghost – end of night
items.synopsis: In the near future, where labor is no longer necessary, only the most talented work and keep the world running.

items.title: Future GPX Cyber Formula ASURADA
items.synopsis: في مستقبل أصبحت فيه سباقات السيارات تعتمد على أنظمة قيادة إلكترونية متطورة، يجد السائق الشاب هاياتو كازامي نفسه خلف مقود سيارة السباق المتقدمة Asurada G.S.X. رغم قلة خبرته، ليبدأ سباقًا يختبر قدراته ويضعه في قلب منافسات Cyber Formula.

items.title: Future GPX Cyber Formula EARLYDAYS RENEWAL MOVIE EDITION
items.synopsis: إصدار سينمائي يعيد تقديم بدايات عالم Future GPX Cyber Formula، حيث يدخل هاياتو كازامي عالم سباقات Cyber Formula بعد ارتباطه بسيارة Asurada المتطورة. وتبدأ رحلته من سائق مبتدئ إلى منافس يسعى لإثبات نفسه في سباقات المستقبل.

items.title: Medalist Movie
items.synopsis: Sequel to Medalist Season 2.

items.title: Golden Kamuy Final Season: Runaway Train Arc
items.genre: Action، Adult Cast، Adventure، Historical، Military
items.synopsis: في هوكايدو خلال عصر ميجي، يواصل سايتشي سوغيموتو والفتاة الآينو أسيربا صراعهما للوصول إلى كنز الذهب المخفي. ومع اقتراب القصة من نهايتها، تنتقل المواجهة الحاسمة إلى قطار هارب يجمع عددًا من الأطراف المتنافسة، في فصل أخير يحدد مصير رحلة البحث عن الكنز.

items.title: MONOGATARI Series: OFF & MONSTER Season - Wazamonogatari: Karen Ogre
items.synopsis: حكاية جديدة من عالم Monogatari تركز على كارين أراراغي، وتعود إلى جانب من قصتها ضمن سلسلة OFF & MONSTER. لم يُنشر بعد ملخص رسمي تفصيلي لأحداث اقتباس Wazamonogatari: Karen Ogre، لذا تظل هذه نبذة تعريفية دون كشف تفاصيل غير مؤكدة.
